verdict.summary: EGFR is a clinically validated drug target in lung cancer, especially EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer. There are multiple approved EGFR-directed therapies, including kinase inhibitors and an EGFR-directed antibody.

disease_links.evidence: FDA-approved EGFR-directed therapies exist for EGFR-mutated NSCLC.

disease_links.disease: EGFR exon 19 deletion / exon 21 L858R NSCLC
disease_links.evidence: Osimertinib is FDA-approved for EGFR-mutated NSCLC with these sensitizing alterations.
Amivantamab is FDA-approved for EGFR exon 20 insertion-mutated NSCLC.

why: Multiple FDA-approved EGFR inhibitors exist for lung cancer.
EGFR is directly druggable at the kinase domain.
EGFR-directed antibody therapy is also available for specific NSCLC subgroups.

candidate_drugs.name: osimertinib
candidate_drugs.relevance: Best-supported EGFR target therapy for sensitizing EGFR-mutant NSCLC; strongest top-line evidence for first-line lung cancer use.
evidence: FDA-approved for EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer with exon 19 deletion or exon 21 L858R, in combination with chemotherapy.
Directly maps to the canonical actionable EGFR-mutant lung cancer subgroup.

candidate_drugs.name: amivantamab
candidate_drugs.relevance: Highly relevant for EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC and other EGFR-driven lung cancer settings.
evidence: FDA-approved for EGFR exon 20 insertion-mutated non-small cell lung cancer indications.
Targets the EGFR-driven subset that is less responsive to older TKIs.

candidate_drugs.name: afatinib
candidate_drugs.relevance: Established EGFR inhibitor for previously untreated metastatic NSCLC with non-resistant EGFR mutations.
evidence: FDA broadened the indication for previously untreated metastatic NSCLC with non-resistant EGFR mutations.
Supports EGFR as a clinically validated lung cancer target.

candidate_drugs.name: dacomitinib
candidate_drugs.relevance: Approved EGFR inhibitor for EGFR-mutant metastatic NSCLC; useful confirmation of tractability.
evidence: Approved as a lung-cancer therapy in the EGFR-mutant NSCLC setting.

candidate_drugs.name: erlotinib
candidate_drugs.relevance: Historical EGFR-targeted therapy for NSCLC, still relevant as evidence that EGFR is a druggable lung cancer target.
evidence: FDA-approved for NSCLC; commonly cited as an EGFR-targeted lung cancer therapy.
